title: Restore canonical preloading and loading main-detail HTTP form entry
description: Close ordinary creation for the two canonical shipping documents. ERP-040 already routes pre-loading/loading-list to EF modules, but ContainerPreLoading.PreLoadingNo and ContainerLoadingList.LoadingListNo are Required with empty defaults while controllers assign server numbers. Restore blank-number real HTTP creation with server-owned IDs/status and correct typed main/detail payloads, preserving optional source identities and row identity ownership. Keep the existing explicit sales-demand and outbound-evidence workspaces reachable from persisted canonical rows; retained line references must survive ordinary edits. Preserve booking/preloading linkage, remaining quantity, approved shipment/return reversal protection, participant/customer scope and transaction ordering. Never manufacture linked IDs from text or create inventory/financial postings as an incidental save. Test fixtures must generate ephemeral process-local JWT signing keys and authenticate through existing controls on fresh dedicated test databases. Browser evidence must use genuine permitted API writes; offline wiring assertions are not browser acceptance and must be labelled honestly. Keep build/test output and TRX under .ai/logs/<task>/ with explicit --results-directory; preserve original failures and never stage generated artifacts. Respect current business document page/basic-data drawer presentation. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: The existing canonical pre-loading/loading-list modules accept blank-number HTTP new documents and return authoritative numbers/IDs. Main/detail save/reload/edit preserves supported optional source references and explicit demand/outbound row evidence; saved rows reach existing evidence workspaces using canonical IDs.

Submit/approve/cancel honor current menu/customer/participant scope and linked booking/preloading/outbound quantity constraints under existing locks/transactions. Invalid quantity, stale/deleted source, ownership mismatch, forged row/reference/status or revoked authority rejects atomically without source, loading, stock, movement, financial or number effects. No silent evidence-link clearing or Oid/Id mapping.

Meaningful isolated SQL/HTTP verification covers blank-number binding, main/detail round trip, explicit evidence retention and authorized state flow versus rejected zero mutations. Real browser proof must use permitted API writes or record an actual missing execution; preserve loading/preloading/evidence regression tests, safe Release/full units and complete logs/TRX.
implementation_evidence: Container2.cs:14-15 and 99-100 mark PreLoadingNo/LoadingListNo Required with empty defaults. ContainerPreLoadingController.Create:77 and ContainerLoadingListController.Create:75 allocate server numbers. modules-doc2.js already defines canonical api/container/pre-loadings and loading-lists. ERP-040/372/373 handles canonical routing and explicit evidence, not ordinary omitted-number binding or form round-trip compatibility.
